notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature that is not indestructible.
Transmogrifying Wand has at least one charge counter on it.
description:
Activate Transmogrifying Wand by paying {1}, tapping and removing a charge counter from it, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Transmogrifying Wand, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Transmogrifying Wand ability, destroying the targeted creature and causing the opponent to create a 2/4 Ox creature token.
When the creature dies, Glissa triggers, returning Transmogrifying Wand from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Transmogrifying Wand by paying {3}, causing it to enter the battlefield with three charge counters on it.
Repeat.
